segments.name: Cryptocurrency mining
segments.description: Mines bitcoin through mining pool participation, converting electrical power into digital currencies at its own facilities.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, for management purposes, the Corporation has four reporting segments namely, cryptocurrency mining, sales of energy, colocation services, and AI data centers.

segments.name: Sales of energy and electricity
segments.description: Sells energy and electricity from its gas fired power plant and sites to the grid and industrial clients.
segments.evidence: The Corporation has four operating segments being cryptocurrency mining, sales of energy and electricity, colocation services, and Tier III AI data centers located in the United States.

segments.name: Colocation services
products: enterprise colocation and AI/GPU infrastructure services
segments.description: Hosts third-party miners under colocation agreements and delivers enterprise colocation and infrastructure services to digital currency customers.
segments.evidence: Digi Power X is focused on developing, owning and operating data center facilities and delivering enterprise colocation and AI/GPU infrastructure services.

segments.name: Tier III AI data centers
segments.description: Develops Tier III AI data center operations for high-performance computing customers, still in the development phase.
segments.evidence: During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Corporation added a new operating segment related to Tier III AI data center operations.

revenueModel.text: Mining pools pay bitcoin for contributed hashrate, while colocation customers and electricity buyers pay for capacity and power.
revenueModel.evidence: For the year ended December 31, 2025, the Corporation primarily recognized revenues with organizations in the digital currency space.

changes.text: In 2025 the Corporation added a new operating segment for Tier III AI data center operations.
changes.evidence: During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Corporation added a new operating segment related to Tier III AI data center operations.
